whats_new: An agent can give up Health types it no longer needs with send --type scope_release; the phone stops sending them without asking the owner, and status reports pending, applied or not_supported. Activity totals (steps, energy, distances) arrive as 15-minute interval sums in sync.summaries; a resent interval replaces the earlier value and is never added to it. Food, water, insulin, inhaler use and similar logged entries stay raw samples. Per-type read/write access waits, filtered refusals and merged pending requests with five admissions and three amendments. V2 pairing sends encrypted Health scope through the relay and keeps the link independent of the requested type count. Access envelopes allow 131072 bytes and ordinary controls allow 4096. V1 scope flags send one ordinary request after verified fingerprint confirmation. Confirmed v2 pairing requires explicit owner approval for a missing-reply fallback and keeps bounded response polling. From agent 0.1.4, receive prints no records to stdout by default; records stay in the inbox, and --emit-records also writes them to stdout. Inbox replay tracking bounds each sender/key binding, protects IDs minted within 24 hours plus ten minutes and stalls without ACK at pathological capacity; safe eviction floors commit atomically with admission. Clarifies installed-agent rules authority, including accepted signed updates newer than the binary, and setup authority; adds shared inline safety, guarded-action prerequisites and durable ACK boundaries. Run pair directly and read its output without redirecting it to a file. In the chat where the owner asked, send the terminal QR verbatim in a fenced block, the HTTPS link, code and expiry in the first reply. Use the configured agent home throughout setup. The terminal QR is narrower, pair --qr-png or --qr-svg writes a private QR image, and pair --show-qr shows the current pairing again without replacing it. Receive guidance explains configured cadence and the ordinary 300-second poll floor, with the floor in pair and receive metadata and the exact deferral deadline on stderr. Save and reuse the local skill during setup. After the first data arrives, ask the owner whether to receive continuously or on demand. Services run the installed receiver directly. With continuous receive, data from the phone can arrive within seconds while Syncky is open during the first sync after pairing. Timing depends on the phone, network and service availability. After sending a command, the agent can check for its acknowledgment sooner with a relay that supports early checks.
